There are 2 main types of chests: [[Chests#Item Chests|Item Chests]] and [[Chests#Relic Chests|Relic Chests]]. There are 2 sub-types of [[Chests#Relic Chests|Relic Chests]]: Mythic Chests and Divine Chests.

== Item Chests == 
[[File:Chests Button.png|right]]
You can get Item Chests in different ways:

* Filling the meter based on damage dealt to rocks 
** Damage required increases exponentially and it caps by ore health.
** You can increase fill rate with regular [[upgrades]] and [[Store#Gem Upgrades|gem upgrades]]. The fill rate does not always noticeably increase, possibly due to extensive periods dealing damage prior to purchasing the upgrade. There may be a cap on how quickly this meter can fill, so rushing all of these upgrades at once is not recommended.
** The "Multi Chest Chance" relic grants additional chests from this method
* From the freebie pack in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Store|Store]]
** This is the primary method of gaining bulk items, relics, and gems over time
*From [[Store#Resource Packs|resource packs]]
*From bimonthly [[Special:MyLanguage/Events|Events]]
*From [[Special:MyLanguage/Lootbugs|Lootbugs]]
*From offline gains
**At a rate of 0.3 per hour

You initially get 1 item per chest (Up to 18 with Gem Upgrades) and there are 13 different types of items.

Items give you a buff for a fixed duration. This duration can be extended. Many items gain secondary effects from [[Archaeology]].

==Relic Chests== 
[[File:Relics Button.png|right]]
You can gain Relic Chests in different ways:

*Filling the meter based on damage dealt to rocks
**Damage required increases exponentially
**You can increase fill rate with regular [[upgrades]] and [[Store#Gem Upgrades|gem upgrades]]. The fill rate does not always noticeably increase, possibly due to extensive periods dealing damage prior to purchasing the upgrade. There may be a cap on how quickly this meter can fill, so rushing all of these upgrades at once is not recommended.
** The "Multi Chest Chance" relic grants additional chests from this method
*10% chance to get one every 10 min from the freebie pack in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Store|Store]]
**The [[Special:MyLanguage/Skill-Tree|Treasure Hunter Skill]] can be used to eventually reach 100% chance, and various upgrades decrease the wait time.
**This is the primary method of gaining Relic Chests over time.
*From [[Store#Resource Packs|resource packs]]
*From bimonthly [[Special:MyLanguage/Events|Events]]
*From [[Special:MyLanguage/Lootbugs|Lootbugs]]
*From offline gains
**At a rate of 0.1 per hour

You receive 1 relic per regular Relic Chest. The relic received will have a random tier  (Common ~48%, Rare ~30%, Epic ~14%, Legendary ~7%, Mythic ~1%, Divine 1/25k (0.004%))

Relics give you permanent perks. Some perks are capped; you won't get any more when you reach the cap. Some capped perks can have their caps increased via the [[Archaeology#tabber-Mythic Idols|Zeus]] idol.

===Mythic Chests===
Mythic chests always give a Mythic Relic. These can be acquired for free from [[Special:MyLanguage/Events|Events]] or [[Special:MyLanguage/Store#Gifts|Gifts]].

===Divine Chests===
Divine chests always give a Divine Relic. These are locked behind real money purchases in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Store|Store]] or for free from [[Special:MyLanguage/Store#Gifts|Gifts]].

===Divine Relic Cap===
Divine relics start with a base of 5, excluding Rainbow Floor Chance. This cap can be increased with a [[Challenges#DivineRelicCap|Divine Challenge Reward]] and the [[Cards#tabber-Legendary_Fish|Cthulhu Card]] to a current total of 35.

==Trivia== 
*Mythic and Divine chests, despite appearing on the same page as relic chests, are entirely separate, and are also refunded separately.
*Skill bits and [[Fishing#Tier 2 Items|Tier 2 items]] from fishing notices do not appear in chests
*All relic, mythic, and divine chests can be refunded to re-roll your relics for 200 gems. This can be used in the mid- to late-game to try to get more Divine relics.
